items.title: Dim Sum Water Bottle (500ml)
items.excerpt:
Inspired by Hong Kong's vibrant food culture, the Dim Sum Water Bottle brings a touch of home to every round. Featuring the Dim Sum Golf Club crest and available in a range of clean, understated colours, it's a simple everyday essential designed for life on and off the course.

Durable, lightweight, and easy to carry, it's perfect for golf, travel, workouts, and daily use. Whether you're walking 18 holes or navigating the city, this bottle is built to keep up.

Features

  • 500ml capacity

  • Stainless steel

  • Lightweight and durable construction

  • Secure carry loop for easy transport

  • Ideal for golf, travel, and everyday use

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Stacked Steamer Headcover (Pre-Sale Waitlist)
items.excerpt:
This is a tribute to the timeless dim sum ritual. Inspired by the bamboo steamers stacked high in bustling teahouses, the Dim Sum Stack headcover brings that warm, familiar hum of Sunday mornings straight to the fairway.

Crafted from plush fabric with a woven‑lid detail, it’s comfort and culture rolled into one — a playful nod to Hong Kong’s culinary heritage and the camaraderie that defines Dim Sum Golf Club.

Soft fleece lining + embroidered logo.

For Driver only for now.

We currently have a community vote on Instagram for the barrel or sock design to be the final headcover. https://www.instagram.com/p/DbiV4m_GdHd/?igsh=MXViMmc4dWx6bXFzNw==

Designed in Hong Kong by Dim Sum Golf Club - All rights reserved.

Note: This item is currently on waitlist — not for sale yet. No price has been set. Images may change slightly before the final release.

items.title: Ball Marker & Sock Set
items.excerpt:
The Ball Marker & Sock Set brings a taste of Hong Kong to the golf course, blending function, style, and local culture into every detail. This set includes 1 x Dim Sum ball marker paired with 1 x comfortable, performance-ready pair of Dim Sum Golf Club socks, all presented in a sleek metal gift box.

Crafted with attention to detail, the ball marker is the perfect size for quick and easy alignment on the greens, while the socks are designed for comfort both on and off the course. Whether you're lining up a putt or walking the fairways, this set adds a playful yet polished touch to your game.

Designed and packed in Hong Kong.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you!

items.title: Vintage Sweatshirt
items.excerpt:
Classic comfort meets timeless identity. The Vintage Sweatshirt features the club’s embroidered emblem — a steamer basket motif that nods to Hong Kong’s culinary heritage and golf’s enduring camaraderie.

Its deep green hue and clean typography evoke old‑school athletic wear, reimagined for modern play. Warm, structured, and unmistakably Dim Sum Golf Club.

Crafted from heavyweight cotton for lasting shape and softness. Perfect for cool mornings on the course or relaxed evenings off it.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Dim Sum Golf Club T-Shirt
items.excerpt:
The Dim Sum Golf Club T-Shirt is a unique blend of golf and Hong Kong culture, featuring a playful design with golf balls, chopsticks, and a bamboo steamer. Made from 100% premium cotton, it’s soft, breathable, and perfect for both the driving range and casual wear. Designed and assembled in Hong Kong, this exclusive tee reflects local design and style.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you!

items.title: Chopstick L/S
items.excerpt:
The Chopstick L/S is a long-sleeve evolution of one of our most iconic designs. Screen-printed front and back, it features the now-signature Dim Sum Golf Club graphic: a pair of chopsticks expertly holding a golf ball, with Dim Sum Golf Club displayed proudly in Chinese and English beneath.

Inspired by Hong Kong’s street-smart style and the quiet precision of both golf and dining, this tee blends culture and sport in one clean, wearable piece. The soft cotton fabric and fit make it ideal for layering, early morning rounds, or post-game hangs at the cha chaan teng.

Finished with bold, durable screen printing on both sides — because the message should be seen from every angle.

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you!

items.title: ProTour Polo Shirt
items.excerpt:
The ProTour Polo is built for style and performance. Crafted from 90% nylon & 10% spandex fabric, this 175g polo is designed to keep you cool, comfortable, and sweat-free — even on the hottest summer days on the course.

Featuring the iconic Hong Kong logo’s with a Dim Sum twist & printed proudly, this polo blends local culture with serious golf practicality. Whether you're walking 18 holes or cooling off with an iced beer post-round, this polo delivers breathable comfort with a side of Hong Kong flair.

Size Guide

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Do not tumble dry.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you!

items.title: Kau Sai Chau T-Shirt
items.excerpt:
A tribute to Hong Kong’s only public golf course — where the city meets the sea. The Kau Sai Chau T‑Shirt captures the calm of a perfect swing against the island’s rolling hills, rendered in crisp blue line art inspired by traditional porcelain illustration.

It’s a design that celebrates local golf heritage and the beauty of play in its purest form. Minimal, timeless, and unmistakably the Hong Kong weekend golfer.

Crafted from soft, durable cotton for comfort. A piece that feels as serene as the view it depicts — built for golfers who know the rhythm of the island breeze.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Essentials Performance Cap
items.excerpt:
Lightweight, structured, and built for play. The Essentials Performance Cap keeps things simple — a curved brim, breathable QuickDry fabric, and the club name embroidered in crisp white across the front.

It’s the go‑to for sunny rounds and everyday wear, balancing function with understated identity. Designed to move with you, whether you’re on the course or off duty.

Durable, quick‑dry, and easy to pack. A staple piece that speaks for itself.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Essential Golf Socks (Pack of Two)
items.excerpt:
The foundation of every round — simple, sharp, and built to last. The Essential Golf Socks deliver comfort and structure with a ribbed design that stays secure through every swing.

Finished with the club’s signature green embroidery, they pair perfectly with any kit.

Soft cotton blend for breathability and durability. From course to clubhouse, they’re the quiet detail that completes the look.

One size

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Low Crown Visor
items.excerpt:
Light, clean, and built for clarity on the course. The Low Crown Visor keeps focus front and centre — shielding your eyes while letting the breeze through.

Finished with soft pink embroidery of the club name and city, it’s understated yet distinctive — a modern nod to classic golf style with a local touch.

Crafted from durable cotton for comfort and breathability. Whether you’re teeing off or winding down, it’s the piece that completes the look without saying too much.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Hongonia T-Shirt
items.excerpt:
A tongue‑in‑cheek homage to the Saigonia tee — and the Patagonia classic that inspired it. The Hongkongonia T‑Shirt reimagines the idea through a local lens, capturing Hong Kong’s skyline in bold, graphic lines and sunset tones.

It’s playful design that nods to global culture while staying rooted in home turf. From Victoria Harbour to the hills beyond, it’s a portrait of the city’s rhythm and resilience, where golf meets everyday hustle. Crafted from premium cotton for comfort and durability.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Sun Sleeves – UPF 50+ (Pack of Two)
items.excerpt:
Built for long days under the sun — from tee‑off to twilight. The Sun Sleeves deliver lightweight protection with a crisp, athletic finish, keeping you cool while shielding your skin from harmful rays.

Minimal branding, maximum function. Featuring the club crest printed near the cuff, they pair seamlessly with any polo or tee for a refined, performance‑driven look.

Soft stretch fabric ensures comfort and mobility through every swing. Wash after wash, they hold their shape and purpose — dependable gear for serious play.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Breakfast Ball Headcover
items.excerpt:
Everyone loves a breakfast ball!

Rise and shine, golfers. This isn’t just a headcover — it’s your favourite start to the day.

Inspired by the bustling cha chaan tengs where milk tea steams, toast crisps, and scrambled eggs  gleam under fluorescent lights, the Breakfast Ball headcover brings the soul of HK’s iconic cafés to the tee box. Think: red leather booths, Formica tables, and that first sip of sweet, silky milk tea.

Faux leather + soft fleece lining.

Features French toast, milk tea, macaroni & ham, egg sandwich and of course spam — all stitched with love.

For Driver only.

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you for your patience!

items.title: Minibus Sign Bag Tag
items.excerpt:
The Minibus Sign Bag Tag is a playful nod to Hong Kong’s iconic urban aesthetic — bringing the bold, vibrant energy of the city’s famous red-and-blue minibus signs to your golf bag. Designed to stand out on the course or in the clubhouse, this tag features the unmistakable design elements that make Hong Kong’s public transport so instantly recognisable.

Crafted with precision and durability, it’s perfect for keeping your gear organised while adding a touch of local flair to your golf accessories.

A must-have for golfers who love Hong Kong culture and want to bring a piece of the city onto the course.

Dimensions: 10.5cm x 6.5cm x 0.4cm

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you!

items.title: Heritage T-Shirt
items.excerpt:
A tribute to Hong Kong’s timeless character — where golf meets culture. The Heritage T‑Shirt carries the club’s bilingual emblem, inspired by classic HK signage and local craftsmanship.

Clean lines, bold typography, and unmistakable identity. It’s a statement of roots and rhythm — from fairways to city streets, this tee connects tradition with modern play.

Crafted from premium cotton for lasting comfort and durability. A design that feels familiar yet fresh, built to stand the test of time and taste.

Note: No refunds. Exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon — thank you for your patience.

items.title: Reversible Golf Gilet
items.excerpt:
The 7-pocket Reversible Golf Gilet is your smartest layer for changeable conditions—whether you're walking the fairways on a crisp morning or keeping things sharp for a casual lunch in town. Lightweight yet warm, it’s crafted from durable polyester and lined with plush fleece for reliable insulation without bulk.

Designed to be worn two ways, this gilet flips from a clean, minimalist front to a subtly textured reverse—offering instant versatility for on-course performance or off-duty ease. The sleeveless cut ensures full range of motion for your swing, while the tailored fit keeps your look tidy and modern.

Perfect for layering over polos or under a wind jacket, it’s built to move with you—and made to last through seasons of wear, both on and off the course.

*Note: Gilets take 7 days to be shipped.

Size chart here

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you!

items.title: Sum-Day Golf Bag
items.excerpt:
SUM-DAY BAG (Pre-Order) — The Light & Lean Companion for Your Sunday Swing

Introducing the Sum-Day Bag from Dim Sum Golf Club. Designed for the casual golfer who values function, flair, and a little bit of fun, this lightweight canvas bag is your go-to for the driving range, weekend rounds, or even just strolling the course with your favourite 9.

Crafted in durable black canvas with minimalist detailing, the Sum-Day Bag features:

✅ Two handy zippered pockets — keep tees, balls, and scorecards secure
✅ A single, sturdy shoulder strap for easy carry (no awkward swings here)
✅ Embroidered “Dim Sum Golf Club — Hong Kong” logo — subtle, stylish, and unmistakably yours
✅ Ultra-lightweight construction — because you’ve got enough to carry already

Whether you’re chasing birdies or just chasing the sun, the Sum-Day Bag keeps it simple, smart, and seriously cool.

THIS IS A PRE-ORDER; SHIPPING WILL BEGIN ON NOVEMBER 6TH

Don’t wait — grab your Sum-Day Bag before they’re gone.

items.title: Dim Sum Golf Club Bangkok Edition Cap
items.excerpt:
100% Cotton
Dad Cap
Designed & assembled in Hong Kong

Price is HK$

*No refunds & exchanges only in Hong Kong (We are working to build on our overseas exchange policy in the future - Thanks)

items.title: Good Morning Microfibre Towel
items.excerpt:
The Good Morning Towel pays tribute to the classic Asian washcloth, reimagined for the course. Measuring 40 x 60cm, it’s made from soft, absorbent fabric that’s perfect for cleaning clubs, wiping hands, or draping over your bag as a subtle style statement. Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Shipping begins July 18th

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you!

items.title: Yaowarat Road T‑Shirt
items.excerpt:
The Yaowarat Road T‑Shirt A vivid tribute to Bangkok’s Chinatown, this piece channels the electric pulse of Yaowarat Road—where neon signs blaze above bustling night markets and the scent of street food fills the air. Reimagining the Dim Sum Golf Club aesthetic through Thai script and bold red‑green accents, it captures the cultural crossroads of heritage and modern hustle.

The design’s interplay of color and language mirrors the district’s iconic glow: crimson storefronts, jade signage, and golden light spilling onto crowded streets. It’s a wearable snapshot of Bangkok’s rhythm—alive, layered, and unapologetically vibrant.

Made for golfers who appreciate both precision and personality, this limited‑edition tee blends streetwear confidence with course‑ready comfort. A celebration of contrasts: tradition meets trend, serenity meets chaos, and every swing carries the spirit of Yaowarat.

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong, inspired by Bangkok’s luminous soul.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. Overseas exchange policy coming soon—thank you for your patience.

items.title: Essential Bucket Hat
items.excerpt:
The Essential Bucket Hat is a timeless classic reimagined with a local touch. Crafted from 100% premium cotton, it offers comfort and durability with a clean, understated look. Whether you're out on the course or exploring the streets of Hong Kong, it’s the perfect everyday accessory. Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you!

items.title: Vintage Cha Chaan Teng Polo Shirt
items.excerpt:
The Vintage Cha Chaan Teng Polo Shirt is a reimagined classic — inspired by the iconic green-and-white (and pink-and-white) tile floors of Hong Kong’s beloved cha chaan tengs, but styled with a bold 90s twist. Think boxy silhouette, relaxed shoulders, and a buttonless open collar for that effortless, retro café vibe.

This isn’t just a polo — it’s a wearable piece of Hong Kong nostalgia, upgraded for modern comfort and golf/streetwise style. The loose, breathable cut keeps you cool whether you're on the course or chasing milk tea at your local diner. And with its nod to 90s casualwear and old-school café culture, it bridges generations of Hong Kong cool.

Asian fit (Size Guide)

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong.

Shipping 30th May 2026

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you for your understanding!

items.title: Dim Sum Golf Club x Mogshade - Cha Chaan Teng Headcovers
items.excerpt:
A love letter to Hong Kong’s most iconic cafés — where green-and-white tiled floors meet red leather chairs and steaming milk tea. This limited-edition headcover collection brings the soul of the cha chaan teng to the golf course.

Crafted with care in Portugal from deadstock 100% wool (outer shell) and lined with soft, recycled fleece, these headcovers are as kind to the planet as they are to your clubs. The classic houndstooth-inspired green-and-white pattern mirrors the timeless floor tiles, while the vibrant red trim nods to those unmistakable café seats.

Available for Driver & 3-Wood, each piece is handcrafted in small batches — making them rare, refined, and ready to turn heads on the tee box.

More than just protection — it’s personality. More than just design — it’s heritage.

Limited Edition. Handcrafted in Portugal. Eco-conscious materials.

Designed by Dim Sum Golf Club & Mogshade.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you!

items.title: Country Club Lightweight Hoodie
items.excerpt:
The Country Club Lightweight Hoodie is your go-to layer for summer mornings on the course or laid-back afternoons off it.

Made from a premium blend of 280gsm 80% cotton and 20% polyester, it balances durability with comfort — perfect for the summer mornings, refined enough for the clubhouse. Finished with a clean, minimalist look, it transitions seamlessly from the 19th hole to city streets.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy—thank you!

items.title: Thai Dim Sum Golf Club T-Shirt
items.excerpt:
The original Dim Sum Golf Club design—now reimagined through a Thai lens. This tee celebrates the shared spirit of Hong Kong and Thailand: vibrant, flavourful, and full of character. Featuring Thai typography and a clean green steamer motif, it’s a nod to the timeless ritual of dim sum mornings and the camaraderie that defines the club.

The minimalist white base keeps things fresh and versatile, while the graphic brings a touch of cultural playfulness—bridging golf’s precision with the warmth of street‑side dining. It’s a piece that feels equally at home on the course or in the city, embodying the easy confidence that runs through every Dim Sum Golf Club creation.

Designed and assembled in Hong Kong, inspired by the flavours and friendships that connect our worlds.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you!

items.title: Thai Chopstick T-Shirt
items.excerpt:
The Chopstick Tee returns—still the perfect fusion of golf precision and Hong Kong soul, now with a Thai twist. Featuring a clean graphic of chopsticks poised mid‑air, gripping a golf ball with effortless balance, this design celebrates the art of control both on the green and at the table.

Below, the Dim Sum Golf Club name appears proudly in Thai and English—a nod to the club’s cross‑cultural spirit and playful sense of identity. It’s a statement piece for those who appreciate the finer details, whether that’s a perfect swing or a perfectly steamed dumpling.

Crafted for comfort and designed to stand out, this tee moves seamlessly from fairway to city streets to your favorite 19th hole. A modern classic that captures the humor, heritage, and harmony at the heart of Dim Sum Golf Club.

Note: No refunds; exchanges available only in Hong Kong. We’re working on expanding our overseas exchange policy — thank you!

items.title: Cha Chaan Teng Microfibre Towel
items.excerpt:
